name: base-agents
description: Generic, stack-agnostic engineering process standards, distributed as versioned, load-on-demand skills plus the write-time hook that makes them fire. Names no product and no stack, so it applies to every repo Tommy owns alongside whichever stack plugin that repo needs.

plugins.name: process-standards
plugins.description: The generic method: branching, committing, opening a PR and landing it through a queue, plans and roadmaps and progress ledgers, handoffs, reviews and addressing what they find, docs and tech debt, worktrees, and driving a red suite to green tier by tier. Ships the skill router hook, so the standard that owns a path is loaded before the file is written. Names no product.
